verdict.rationale: Fireworks has a dedicated batch inference guide that says you can process large volumes of requests asynchronously at 50% off Serverless per-token prices. That directly covers both the async batch capability and the documented discount versus real-time pricing. However, the evidence is a single repeated line from that page, with nothing on how jobs are actually submitted. Missing for 10: details of the job submission workflow (API/CLI endpoints, input file format, job status or result retrieval), turnaround window or SLA, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
